items.answer: year 1: depreciation ₹67,200, accumulated ₹67,200, book value ₹3,57,800; year 2: depreciation ₹67,200, accumulated ₹1,34,400, book value ₹2,90,600; year 3: depreciation ₹67,200, accumulated ₹2,01,600, book value ₹2,23,400; year 4: depreciation ₹67,200, accumulated ₹2,68,800, book value ₹1,56,200; year 5: depreciation ₹67,200, accumulated ₹3,36,000, book value ₹89,000
items.markingKey: Annual depreciation (425000 − 89000)/5 = 67200 (1 mark); accumulated depreciation and book value each year (3 marks); final book value equals scrap value ₹89,000 (1 mark).

items.stem: In a class test, Zoya is given the equation (d²y/dx²)³ + (dy/dx)⁵ + y = 0 and the equation y″ + e^(y′) = x. (i) Find the order and degree of the first equation. (ii) Find the order of the second and explain why its degree is not defined. (iii) How many arbitrary constants would the general solution of the first equation have?
items.answer: (i) order 2, degree 3 (ii) order 2; e^(y′) is not a polynomial in y′ (iii) 2

items.stem: Aditi manages shift schedules at a factory in Coimbatore. (i) Today is Wednesday; a machine is due for service after 288 days. On which day is the service? (ii) A batch starts at 13:00 and takes 137 hours. At what time (24-hour clock) does it end? (iii) Find the remainder when 2⁴⁸ is divided by 5.
items.markingKey: (i) 288 mod 7 = 1 (1 mark) (ii) (13 + 137) mod 24 = 6 (1 mark) (iii) cycle of powers modulo 5 (2 marks).

items.stem: Shreya tracks the yearly production (thousand tonnes) of a sugar mill near Shimla for 2016–2022: 84, 90, 97, 102, 103, 105, 113. (i) How many 3-yearly moving averages can be found? (ii) Find them. (iii) Against which years are the first and last placed?
